ModMetaData.name: Gravship Roof Solar
ModMetaData.author: 9ranr11d
ModMetaData.description:
Roof-mounted solar panels for gravships and substructure bases.
- A 4x4 solar panel that sits on top of the roof, so it can be built over walls, furniture, workbenches and wiring without using floor space - Same cost, power (1700 W), hit points and research as the vanilla solar generator; output follows sunlight and is not reduced by the roof it sits on - Needs substructure and a roof under all 16 cells. If any roof cell is lost (drop pod, roof removed, collapse) or the substructure disappears, the panel is destroyed and leaves the usual wreckage - Safe through gravship takeoff and landing - Drawn only when selected or while the power grid overlay is showing, so it never hides what is underneath - Plants growing below (e.g. hydroponics) are not cleared when the panel is built - Removing the mod only removes the panels
Limits: - A panel straddling the edge of a gravship engine's range is not carried by the ship - If the roof under a blueprint is removed before it is finished, the panel is destroyed on completion - Each panel needs a power conduit or other power transmitter within 6 cells of its center - It is not shielded from fire or explosions in the rooms below
